summary: FOODbakēd Pass 1 Live Orders E2E — Backend 24/24 (6 test_food_orders + 16 test_food_reservations_e2e + 2 new test_food_order_ws_fanout). Frontend verified live via Playwright: partner auth login works (after seeding qa-burger partner via admin API), portal-wide notification engine fires on /partner/food (DASHBOARD) when a customer order is POSTed → modal data-testid=partner-order-modal appears without refresh, Accept closes modal and server-side status becomes 'accepted', PATCH preparing/ready transitions persist (200 OK), modal also appears on fresh /partner/food/orders page. P0.1 confirmed — /api/food/restaurants/burger_hub_ci/menu returns is_available:true on all 9 items. Order flow end-to-end works. CRITICAL ISSUE: the FR/EN parity requirement is violated across the entire Partner Portal — all strings are hardcoded as bilingual concatenation 'Accepter · Accept', 'Refuser · Reject', 'Nouvelle commande · New order', 'À emporter · Pickup', '1 article(s) · item(s)', nav items ('Tableau de bord · Dashboard', 'Commandes · Orders', 'Se déconnecter · Sign out'), 'Activer les alertes · Enable alerts', etc. — directly contradicting the spec's 'No bilingual concatenation like Accepter · Accept allowed'.

minor.issue: qa-burger@test.example partner user had to be re-created via admin API before UI tests (login returned 401). The seed_food_microsite_demo.py script does NOT recreate the QA partner account. Add partner create/upsert to the seed to prevent regression.

ui_bugs.component: RestaurantNotificationEngine.jsx (IncomingOrderModal + IncomingModal) + PartnerApp.jsx sidebar + Orders page tabs/CTA + CartDrawer.jsx FOOD CTA fallback
ui_bugs.issue: ALL Partner Portal strings are hardcoded bilingual concatenations ('Accepter · Accept', 'Refuser · Reject', 'Nouvelle commande · New order', 'À emporter · Pickup', 'Livraison · Delivery', '1 article(s) · item(s)', 'autre(s) en attente · more waiting', 'Activer les alertes · Enable alerts', sidebar 'Tableau de bord · Dashboard', 'Commandes · Orders', 'Réservations · Reservations', 'Profil · Profile', 'Paramètres · Settings', 'Se déconnecter · Sign out', 'Motif · Reason', 'Confirmer le refus', cart fallback 'Commander FOOD · Place food order'). Spec explicitly bans this and requires react-i18next FR/EN switching.

Reject reason uses a <select> dropdown (data-testid=partner-order-modal-reason) with 5 bilingual options ('Restaurant trop occupé · Too busy' etc.). Spec names 'reject-reason-input' suggesting a free-text input. Functionally OK but non-standard testid name and bilingual option labels.
Modal data-testid is 'partner-order-modal' but spec expected 'new-food-order-modal' or 'incoming-order-popup'. Not blocking since testid is still unique and works.

issues: No language toggle visible on the Partner Portal — strings are hardcoded bilingual. The customer side correctly uses react-i18next (confirmed in iteration_95) but the Partner Portal has none. Introduce t()-based i18n and remove the '·' bilingual pattern.

action_items: P0: Migrate Partner Portal strings (RestaurantNotificationEngine.jsx, PartnerApp.jsx sidebar/login, PartnerOrdersPage.jsx tab labels + action buttons, PartnerReservations*.jsx, CartDrawer FOOD fallback) to react-i18next. Replace every 'FR · EN' concatenated literal with t(key) and add FR + EN locale entries. Spec: 'No bilingual concatenation allowed.' This is the headline P1 blocker — backend + wiring are correct, UX layer is not.

P1: Fix stale-closure bug in RestaurantNotificationEngine WS onmessage handler — audioReady and settings are captured once at mount (useEffect deps [restaurantId, token] with eslint-disable). If a user clicks 'Enable alerts' AFTER WS has already connected, the chime will never play even though modal displays. Fix with a ref (audioReadyRef.current / settingsRef.current) read inside onmessage instead of captured values.
P1: Add qa-burger@test.example partner to seed_food_microsite_demo.py (or create a dedicated seed step) so re-running the seed does not break UI auth after a DB reset. Idempotent upsert expected.

P2: Consider renaming data-testid to 'new-food-order-modal' and the reject-reason input to 'reject-reason-input' to match spec conventions. Also consider using a text <input> or a <select>+'Autre' fallback to a textarea for the reason, since the current <select> is bilingual-labeled.
critical_code_review_comments: RestaurantNotificationEngine.jsx line 183-186: `// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` with deps [restaurantId, token] intentionally omits audioReady/settings — bug: onmessage uses stale closure of audioReady. Modal shows but chime never plays after user arms audio post-connect. Use refs.
RestaurantNotificationEngine.jsx entire JSX: hardcoded bilingual strings ('Accepter · Accept' etc.) — violates spec and prevents true FR/EN switching.

rca of the issue: FR/EN parity: Partner Portal was authored with bilingual concatenated literals as a quick way to serve both languages without wiring i18n. The spec mandates proper react-i18next locale switching (as the customer side has). RCA: lack of i18n plumbing on PartnerApp.jsx subtree. Mitigation: wrap PartnerApp in the existing i18n provider (already present at app root), add partner.json locale namespaces for FR and EN, replace every '·' literal with t('partner.foo.bar'). Stale closure RCA: eslint-disable with intentional omission of audioReady/settings — bug introduced to avoid WS churn. Mitigation: use useRef() to track latest audioReady/settings and read ref.current inside onmessage.
